business_summary: G-III Apparel Group, Ltd. designs, sources, and markets women's and men's apparel in the United States and internationally. It operates through two segments, Wholesale Operations and Retail Operations. The company offers outerwear, dresses, sportswear, swimwear, women's suits, performance wear, suit separates, athleisure, jeans, handbags, footwear, accessories, small leather goods, cold weather accessories, and luggage. It markets apparel and other products under the its owned brands, including Andrew Marc, DKNY, Donna Karan, Eliza J, G.H. Bass, G-III for Her, G-III Sports by Carl Banks, Jessica Howard, Karl Lagerfeld, Karl Lagerfeld Paris, Marc New York, Sonia Rykiel, Vilebrequin, and Wilsons Leather; and under its licensed brands, such as BCBG, Calvin Klein, Champion, Cole Haan, Converse, Dockers, French Connection, Halston, Kenneth Cole, Kensie, Levi's, Margaritaville, Nautica, Tommy Hilfiger, and Vince Camuto. The company also engages in licensed team sports business that has partnerships with the National Football League, National Basketball Association, Major League Baseball, and National Hockey League, as well as U.S. colleges and universities. It distributes its products through retailers, digital channels, and online retail partners. G-III Apparel Group, Ltd. was founded in 1956 and is based in New York, New York.
business_summary_ko: G-III Apparel Group, Ltd.는 미국 및 해외에서 여성 및 남성 의류를 디자인, 공급 및 판매합니다. 도매 운영과 소매 운영이라는 두 부문을 통해 운영됩니다. 이 회사는 겉옷, 드레스, 스포츠웨어, 수영복, 여성 정장, 기능성 의류, 정장 세퍼레이트, 애슬레저, 청바지, 핸드백, 신발, 액세서리, 소형 가죽 제품, 방한용 액세서리 및 수하물을 제공합니다. Andrew Marc, DKNY, Donna Karan, Eliza J, G.H. 등 자체 브랜드로 의류 및 기타 제품을 판매합니다. Bass, G-III for Her, G-III Sports by Carl Banks, Jessica Howard, Karl Lagerfeld, Karl Lagerfeld Paris, Marc New York, Sonia Rykiel, Vilebrequin 및 Wilsons Leather; BCBG, Calvin Klein, Champion, Cole Haan, Converse, Dockers, French Connection, Halston, Kenneth Cole, Kensie, Levi's, Margaritaville, Nautica, Tommy Hilfiger 및 Vince Camuto와 같은 라이선스 브랜드로 운영됩니다. 이 회사는 또한 미국 풋볼 리그(National Football League), 미국 농구 협회(National Basketball Association), 메이저 리그 야구(Major League Baseball), 내셔널 하키 리그(National Hockey League)는 물론 미국 대학과 파트너십을 맺은 라이선스 팀 스포츠 사업에도 참여하고 있습니다. 그것은 자사의 제품을 배포합니다
